title: Duplication of bluetooth meter values messing with graph and calibration
symptom: Historic glucose levels from Accu-Check Aviva Connect or Contour Next meters sometimes suddenly appear on the graph at a wrong time, often multiple times, and can mess with Libre calibration. The repeated values appear a few hours in the past, not close to a recent reading.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause, but suggests it is caused by bluetooth sync duplication.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. A workaround mentioned is disabling automatic calibration or clicking on BG in graph and calibrating. The original reporter later states they have not observed the issue in many months and assumes it is fixed.
evidence_quote: I have not observed this issue in many months. I would therefore assume it's fixed at least for my case.
